newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mercury Air Cargo names Ritchie president.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mercury Air Cargo names Ritchie president.

text.p: U.S. airfreight space broker and North American airline cargo handler and general sales agent Mercury Air Group Inc said it has appointed Steven Ritchie as president of subsidiary Mercury Air Cargo.
It said that Ritchie, currently president and chief executive of Los Angeles-based U.S. independent cargo handler, Gateway Freight Services, will take up his new position on August 1.

A Mercury statement said that Ritchie had 30 years' experience in the air cargo industry, having previously held positions with Control Data Corp, Circle International (HARG.O, MSAS International OGP.L and Fritz FRTZ.O Air Freight.
He succeeds Joseph Czyzyk, who was promoted to president of Mercury Air Group in 1994. The Mercury Air Cargo presidency had remained vacant since then.
